messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — found a regression in the Python SDK snippet for streaming pagination in the docs. The example loses the retry wrapper when migrating to async. PR incoming.
kevin: Thanks, can you paste the problematic snippet?
marta: Sure — current docs show:
```py
async for chunk in client.responses.stream(...):
    print(chunk)
```
but it should include the retry decorator/context we use in codegen, e.g.:
```py
from redwood import retry
@retry(on_exceptions=(TimeoutError,))
async def stream_resp():
    async for chunk in client.responses.stream(...):
        yield chunk
```
samir: Oof. That will break users who rely on built-in backoff. Do you have a PR number?
marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418 — draft, needs review and a short migration note for TS/Go.
lia: For TS we should avoid decorator syntax — suggest an example using a retry helper:
```ts
await retry(async () => {
  for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream(...)) {
    console.log(chunk)
  }
})
```
kevin: What about Go? Keep it minimal: mention context with backoff and example using `backoff.Retry`.
samir: I'll add a small paragraph to the migration guide highlighting this gotcha and add a tiny unit test snippet to the examples repo.
docs-bot: Reminder: link-checker will run on merge; add changelog entry.
marta: Thanks — assigning reviews: @kevin, @lia, @samir. Aim to merge today. :thumbsup:
